entities.summary: Zaw Min Tun is a Burmese army general and senior government spokesperson. He has served as Deputy Minister of Information of Myanmar since 7 February 2021 and as Information Team Leader of the National Defence and Security Council (NDSC) since 3 September 2025. After the 2021 Myanmar coup d'état, he became a regular spokesperson for the Myanmar military and government, delivering official statements to domestic and international media. He has also held multiple military information roles, including Director of Public Relations and Psychological Warfare of the Myanmar Army, Head of the Press Team of the State Administration Council, and Chief of the Tatmadaw True News Information Team.
